summary.zh: 实验版本（不占用正式更新通道，仅进 beta 列车）：新增「编排工具」——让助手把一整串工具调用写成一段程序一次跑完：列目录、翻文件、并发搜索都可以在一个小剧本里完成，中间过程不进聊天记录，只在下方缩进列出每一步的成败与耗时，点开可看参数与完整结果；每个子步骤仍走与手动调用相同的逐项审批。这一版还带上了按需工具加载（常驻工具面瘦身约 76%）、工作区技能热更新与逐个开关、模型观测子标签页、回退检查点，以及 rg/fd/ast-grep 搜索组件随安装包内置；修复了代码运行台与语言服务工具在 macOS/Linux 上缺失的问题。
summary.en: Experimental build (beta train only, never Latest): adds the Orchestration tool — the assistant writes one program that runs a whole chain of tool calls (list, read, fan-out searches) in one shot; intermediate results stay out of the chat and appear as an indented list of sub-steps with status, timing, expandable arguments and full outputs, each sub-step still gated by the same per-call approvals as manual calls. Also bundled since 0.1.39: on-demand tool loading (~76% smaller resident tool surface), per-skill workspace hot toggles, observability sub-tabs, rollback checkpoints, rg/fd/ast-grep shipped inside the installer, and a fix restoring the code-runner and language-service tools on macOS/Linux.

title.zh: 编排工具：一段程序跑完一串工具调用
title.en: Orchestration tool: one program runs a whole chain of tool calls

summary.zh: 助手可以把多步工作写成一段异步程序一次性执行：循环、并发、条件分支都可以，程序里 await 调用本会话的任意工具。中间结果留在沙箱里不占对话上下文，只有程序打印的内容与最终返回值回到聊天；每一步子调用单独走权限审批，与手动调用同权。
summary.en: The assistant can write one async program that performs multi-step work in a single call — loops, concurrency and conditionals included, awaiting any session tool. Intermediate results stay in a sandbox outside the conversation; only printed output and the return value come back. Every sub-call goes through the same per-call permission gates as manual calls.

details.zh: 聊天里编排工具行下方缩进列出每一步：工具名、成败、耗时，点开可看参数与完整结果，与正常调用完全同源。
details.en: Below the orchestration row, each sub-step is listed indented with tool name, status and timing, expanding to arguments and full output exactly like a normal call.

details.zh: 程序在无文件系统与网络访问的隔离沙箱中执行，墙钟 10 分钟、内存 256MB、输出 128KB、并发 8 路封顶。
details.en: The program runs in an isolated sandbox with no filesystem or network access, capped at 10 minutes wall clock, 256 MB memory, 128 KB output and 8 concurrent sub-calls.

details.zh: 长任务的中间过程不再刷屏：一次编排内部可以递归翻目录、并发搜索，只占对话一次调用。
details.en: Long tasks stop flooding the transcript: one orchestration can walk directories and fan out searches internally while occupying a single conversation call.

title.zh: 按需工具加载：常驻工具面瘦身约 76%
title.en: On-demand tool loading: resident tool surface shrinks ~76%

summary.zh: 每轮对话常驻的工具清单收缩到最核心的四个（读、写、改、执行命令），其余全部进目录按需取用：助手先搜目录、看说明再调用。直载面从约 37KB 降到 8.9KB，长对话更省、缓存更稳。
summary.en: The per-turn resident tool list shrinks to the core four (read, write, edit, exec); everything else moves into a searchable catalog the assistant consults on demand. The resident surface drops from ~37KB to 8.9KB, saving tokens and stabilizing caching on long conversations.

summary.en: Project-bundled skills reload without a restart, and each one can be toggled off individually; closing the master switch hides them all.

summary.en: The assembly list only wired these two tools on Windows (twice, deduped silently); macOS and Linux sessions never got them. All three platforms now match.
